page.title: Civilian Economy
page.t: A public delivery hub serving the sector's civilian population. Construction is funded by the planetary economy. Once completed, it purchases goods for immediate civilian consumption.
Testing shortcut: invokes native instant build completion. May bypass construction materials and time. Reopen this menu for the next module.
Diagnostic snapshot updated every game minute and after recorded deliveries. Reopen the menu to refresh. Earlier uncounted deliveries cannot be reconstructed.
Civilian Economy: this save contains the old energy-only prototype. Load a save from before installing Civilian Economy to test leveling. No migration or additional hub was created.
